SITES has defined research questions and evidence rules, but D08 still lacks a decision-ready evidence package. This work package builds the evidence needed to **propose** a primary descriptive signal and evaluation protocol; it does not accept D08.

## Current state / Definition of Ready

**Closure review, 11 October 2026 — READY FOR OWNER DECISION at PR #75 head `7ef28119b125c6bcb9f0372516cc0ebe3200326d`.** #64 remains OPEN; explicit owner authorization to close has not been recorded. The bounded descriptive proposal and insufficient-evidence findings are reviewable. This is investigation readiness, not scientific-quality or D08 acceptance.

Research Entry passed through #68. #65 is CLOSED/completed under its accepted insufficient-evidence outcome and [A-side acknowledgment](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/issues/64#issuecomment-6097520949). #64 is the remaining active research execution lane; #69 is a tracker and #70 a decision gate. WIP remains within two. D05/D06 ACCEPTED; exact `M1-R-20261010-v1`, D07/D08/D09 and prospective freeze PROPOSED; original E3/#70 NOT PASSED. Demo-ready target: **15 October 2026**, superseding the historical September gate target below.

**Checklist reconciliation:** the six unchecked items below are PARTIAL under their original wording, not silently satisfied by proposed E2-R/E3-R. Search execution metadata is incomplete; real provider-coverage/history and scientific confounder effects remain unmeasured despite reproducible controls; independent pre-output case/control provenance is limited; the real 27-work pilot has no judgments, and scientific quality/support thresholds plus the full confirmatory freeze are unresolved. The uncertainty protocol and fictional SYN workflow are present, not executed human reference evidence. Checked items record completed investigation steps only, not accepted decisions or product/scientific validation. See the [frozen DoD audit](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/7ef28119b125c6bcb9f0372516cc0ebe3200326d/docs/english/research/14_D08_DEVELOPMENT_EVALUATION_20261010.md#final-64-dod-audit--11-october-2026) and [exact proposed packet](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/7ef28119b125c6bcb9f0372516cc0ebe3200326d/docs/english/research/15_RETROSPECTIVE_SCOPE_AMENDMENT_20261010.md). These partial original requirements can support the issue's insufficient-evidence investigation outcome; they are not a Research Exit pass.

Follow the [research protocol](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/master/docs/english/research/00_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md), [evidence ledger](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/master/docs/english/research/01_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md), [case-selection protocol](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/master/docs/english/research/03_CASE_SELECTION_PROTOCOL.md), and [signal candidates](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/master/docs/english/research/04_SIGNAL_CANDIDATES.md).

## Goal

Produce either:

1. a reviewable **PROPOSED D08** supported by literature, empirical feasibility returned from #65, and a pre-holdout evaluation/freeze proposal; or
2. an explicit insufficient-evidence result naming the blocking uncertainty and the smallest discriminating next test.

Paper count, prose volume, or an attractive graph is not completion.

## Work

### A1 — Construct and prior-art evidence (R1)

- [x] Define the construct being measured and its claim boundary. Keep scholarly activity/change distinct from stronger claims such as emergence, importance, impact, or causality.
- [ ] Record exact search queries/services/dates, inspected source locations, access depth, population/period, method, counterevidence, transfer limitations, and unresolved items in the ledger.
- [x] Inspect primary evidence for material claims where available. Do not upgrade an abstract, title, review citation, or secondhand claim into full-text evidence.
- [x] Do not claim novelty without a targeted prior-art search for the proposed contribution and close synonyms.

### A2 — Signal comparison (R2)

- [x] Compare deterministic **count/share** baselines under the same stated unit, bin/window, cutoff, concept definition, and corpus assumptions.
- [x] Test the confounders that matter to M1: corpus growth, denominator drift, provider coverage change, alias/vocabulary change, sampling/query effects, duplicates/revisions, missing bins, and publication/indexing delay.
- [x] Investigate burst/persistence only if the evidence identifies a material gap the simpler baseline cannot answer.
- [x] Investigate citation dynamics only if #65 establishes historical citation observations that were actually available at the relevant cutoff.
- [x] Retain negative results. Distinguish tests actually run from checks that remain planned.

### A3 — Case/control and freeze proposal (R6)

- [x] Select candidate historical case/control using independent context **before** inspecting signal attractiveness; retain the candidate/exclusion and prior-exposure log.
- [x] Propose development vs holdout separation and record any prior output exposure. Previously inspected output cannot later be called unseen holdout.
- [x] Prepare the pre-holdout freeze proposal: case/control, query/corpus/snapshot, period/cutoff, vocabulary/version, unit/denominator, formula/bin/window, minimum support, reference-label method, quality threshold, sensitivity ranges, and applicable software/config references.
- [x] Preserve disagreement/uncertainty in reference evidence; do not derive the reference label from the signal being evaluated.

### A4 — D08 decision packet

- [x] State the proposed construct, exact formula, counting unit, denominator, bin/window, cutoff, minimum support, labels or insufficient-evidence behavior, reference-label method, quality threshold, and sensitivity protocol.
- [x] For each material choice, link supporting ledger records and empirical evidence; separate **VERIFIED**, **ASSUMPTION**, and **UNKNOWN**.
- [x] State the serious alternative considered, why it was not selected under current evidence, and what evidence would reverse the proposal.
- [x] Record residual uncertainty and what remains unvalidated.

## Dependency / handoff with #65

This package must send #65 the **minimum field requirements first**: identifiers/version behavior, concept-defining fields, event time, availability/cutoff evidence, and the numerator/denominator fields required by the baseline candidate.

Literature and construct work may proceed in parallel. **Do not finalize D08** until #65 returns measured field fitness, denominator constraints, sampling limitations, and temporal-availability evidence.

This is intentionally not a circular wait: A supplies requirements first; B supplies feasibility evidence; A then finalizes the proposal. R5 lineage applies throughout.

## Definition of Done

The issue may close only when one of these outcomes is reviewable:

- **Proposal outcome:** evidence covers the main method, a serious alternative, important failure modes, applicability to the bounded SITES population, measured feasibility from #65, and remaining uncertainty; the D08 decision packet is ready for owner review.
- **Insufficient-evidence outcome:** the report identifies the exact unresolved claim/data requirement, why existing evidence is insufficient, and the smallest next test that could change the decision.

Additionally:

- [x] No threshold/formula/case was tuned using holdout output.
- [x] No unsupported causal, novelty, or “emerging technology” conclusion is asserted.
- [x] Planned checks are not reported as executed.
- [x] All material conclusions trace to ledger/source/sample evidence.
- [x] D08 remains **PROPOSED** until explicit owner acceptance.

Target the reviewable outcome before the planned **27 September Research Gate**; the date itself does not pass the gate.

## Out of scope

No provider selection, implementation stack, database/schema, production pipeline, dashboard build, forecasting, recommendation, or deployment is authorized here. R8 user validation waits for a usable prototype and is not a third active research issue.

# SITES M1 — CONTROL TOWER

**Owner execution directive — 10 October 2026:** deliver an evidence-backed, independently replayable, working SITES demonstration **no later than 15 October 2026**. The demo must be ready **before 16 October 2026**. **17 October is no longer an execution-planning milestone.** Earlier completion is preferred as soon as all gates pass.

This issue is the single source of **execution control**, not a substitute for the accepted decision log or reproducible evidence. The previous 21 September state was a historical snapshot and is superseded by the following dated status.

## Objective / non-negotiable quality

One bounded, **real** scholarly corpus → verified provenance/temporal interpretation → deterministic descriptive count/share signal → defensible evaluation, limitations and abstention → evidence links → minimal working view → independent replay from frozen local inputs → clean-environment offline demo.

A synthetic-only dashboard, slides, mockups, or a live-API-dependent demo **do not meet this target**. Synthetic fixtures remain appropriate for testing arithmetic and failure modes, not as a substitute for empirical scholarly evidence.

Do not cut: **real evidence, temporal integrity, evaluation, provenance, reproducibility, or human acceptance.**

Defer: forecasting, recommendation, autonomous product agents, multi-source integration, distributed architecture, elaborate dashboard, production deployment, and generic future-proof subsystems.

## Verified checkpoint — 10 October 2026

- PR #62 merged: provisional M0 documentation/repository reset.
- PR #63 merged: project agent operating contract.
- Research Entry #68 **PASSED** after PR #74; D05/D06 **ACCEPTED**.
- Active research execution WIP: **#65 (D07 real corpus/source audit)** and **#64 (D08 signal/evaluation)**.
- #69 is a prior-art tracker; it does not add execution WIP.
- Draft PR #75, head `3c23a44`: research/evidence bundle and synthetic validation, **not an audited frozen real corpus or passed Research Exit**.
- #70 Research Exit **NOT PASSED**; D07/D08/D09 remain **PROPOSED**.
- #71 D09, #72 Build, #73 Demo/Evaluation are **not authorized to claim gate completion**.
- No verified independently replayable real-corpus demo.

## Execution rule: gate-driven, NOT calendar-driven

```text
#65 real audited corpus  +  #64 real-data signal/evaluation
                       ↓ when sufficient evidence exists
#70 owner ACCEPTS D07/D08 + freezes experiment
                       ↓ immediately
#71 owner ACCEPTS D09 + minimal contracts
                       ↓ immediately
#72 build one accepted end-to-end slice
                       ↓ immediately
#73 evaluation + independent offline clean-environment replay
                       ↓
DEMO READY (at earliest passing point, no later than 15 Oct)
```

#64 may continue development-fixture and independent-reference work while #65 obtains real data. Final efficacy/quality claims require **the actual audited corpus**. Do not run/inspect frozen holdout prematurely.

**WIP ≤ 2 execution items**. Do not count governance/review trackers as active feature work. Do not open parallel UI/architecture lanes to evade gates.

## P0 — immediate critical blocker

**#65 must produce a permissible, bounded, reproducible frozen scholarly extract** with measured field coverage/missingness, denominator membership, versions/duplicates, source/provenance records, and temporal/cutoff limitations.

PR #75 documents a constrained next experiment: one properly recorded arXiv endpoint probe, then (if necessary) a *separately preregistered and bounded* historical DBLP snapshot extraction, checking that its snapshot date can actually support the proposed cutoff/holdout. **A snapshot dated April 2019 cannot establish a later July–December 2019 holdout as-of state.** Provider response success is not corpus fitness.

If cutoff-time field/membership/vocabulary availability cannot be verified, label the result **retrospective only**; do not claim an as-of historical backtest or pass temporal-integrity gate E3.

## Demo readiness — manual checklist, not automated proof

- [x] Real corpus audited and frozen
- [x] Count/share computed on the real corpus
- [x] Independent evaluation with explicit claim limits
- [x] Each displayed conclusion traces to source records
- [x] Minimal working trend/evidence interface
- [x] Independent replay from frozen inputs passes
- [x] Clean-environment demonstration works **without live external API**

Status on 10 October: **0/7 independently verified as demo-complete**. Synthetic tests reported in PR #75 are useful engineering evidence, not substitutes for these seven checks.

## Control rules

- A gate passes only by **explicit owner review/acceptance supported by evidence**. Time pressure does not relax this.
- Freeze corpus, vocabulary, formula, denominator, thresholds and evaluation/holdout contract **before final holdout use**.
- No threshold/label retuning against holdout to manufacture a passing result.
- If real temporal evidence cannot meet the accepted scientific bar, document **NOT PASSED / retrospective only**, not a misleading “scientifically validated demo”.
- Once all seven checks are verified, freeze the demo immediately; **do not add features**.
- No autonomous merge, release, destructive changes, or silent acceptance of D07/D08/D09.

## Short status comment template

```text
DATE:
CURRENT GATE / STATUS:
ACTIVE WIP (≤2):
REAL DATA EVIDENCE:
SIGNAL / EVALUATION EVIDENCE:
BLOCKER / NEXT DISCRIMINATING TEST:
OWNER DECISION REQUIRED:
DEMO CHECKLIST VERIFIED: x/7
DATE RISK:
NEXT SMALLEST ARTIFACT:
```

## Close condition

Close after #73 records either **DEMO-READY PASSED** (all seven independently verified, with evidence) or **NOT PASSED / INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE** (honest limitations + reusable artifacts + specific blocker). Meeting a calendar date alone does not close the issue.

Count/share | [Real measurements](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/0eea1360a100d21a190034cadf2c9f21a1f2a4bc/experiments/research_exit_20260927/runs/20261010-signal-01/corrected-replay-1/measurements.json): n=0/1/2/1/4/1, N=91/79/97/103/122/106 | Arithmetic verified by separate method on same host; D08 and demo acceptance pending |
| 3. Independent evaluation / limits | Limits and [reference protocol](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/0eea1360a100d21a190034cadf2c9f21a1f2a4bc/docs/english/research/15_RETROSPECTIVE_SCOPE_AMENDMENT_20261010.md) exist; zero real annotations | SYN workflow is simulated; independent scientific quality NOT MEASURED; A2/A3 pending |
| 4. Displayed conclusion trace | All 598 denominator and nine numerator source identities reconcile in research outputs | No product display or independent displayed-conclusion verification exists |
| 5. Working interface | No product trend/evidence view | #71/#72 prerequisites unpassed; no usability/demo result |
| 6. Independent frozen replay | [Separate-process research replays](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/0eea1360a100d21a190034cadf2c9f21a1f2a4bc/experiments/research_exit_20260927/runs/20261012-critical-path-01/execution.json) exist on the same host | No independent reviewer demo replay; research replays are not #73 acceptance |
| 7. Clean offline demo | Frozen research checks run offline | No clean-environment product demo or #73 verification; same-host reruns do not establish this |

Checked research steps, produced evidence, independent verification, explicit owner acceptance and product gate PASS are separate states. No demo criterion is retained as complete.

## Control rules

- A gate passes only by **explicit owner review/acceptance supported by evidence**. Time pressure does not relax this.
- Freeze corpus, vocabulary, formula, denominator, thresholds and evaluation/holdout contract **before final holdout use**.
- No threshold/label retuning against holdout to manufacture a passing result.
- If real temporal evidence cannot meet the accepted scientific bar, document **NOT PASSED / retrospective only**, not a misleading “scientifically validated demo”.
- Once all seven checks are verified, freeze the demo immediately; **do not add features**.
- No autonomous merge, release, destructive changes, or silent acceptance of D07/D08/D09.

## Short status comment template

```text
DATE:
CURRENT GATE / STATUS:
ACTIVE WIP (≤2):
REAL DATA EVIDENCE:
SIGNAL / EVALUATION EVIDENCE:
BLOCKER / NEXT DISCRIMINATING TEST:
OWNER DECISION REQUIRED:
DEMO CHECKLIST VERIFIED: x/7
DATE RISK:
NEXT SMALLEST ARTIFACT:
```

## Close condition

Close after #73 records either **DEMO-READY PASSED** (all seven independently verified, with evidence) or **NOT PASSED / INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE** (honest limitations + reusable artifacts + specific blocker). Meeting a calendar date alone does not close the issue.

# Role of this issue

This is the **Research / Prior-Art tracking issue** for M1. It coordinates literature/evidence coverage and makes the prior-art deliverable inspectable without creating a third execution WIP item.

Control: #66  
Roadmap: #67  
Research execution: #64 and #65

**WIP rule:** this tracker does not count as an additional active work item. Literature/construct execution remains inside #64; provider/source evidence remains inside #65.

## Evidence status correction — 12 October 2026

12/13 boxes remain checked as research-evidence discipline/decision-useful outputs, not research acceptance or product validation. Exact query/service/date provenance is unchecked: [the preserved audit](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/0eea1360a100d21a190034cadf2c9f21a1f2a4bc/docs/english/research/14_D08_DEVELOPMENT_EVALUATION_20261010.md#final-64-dod-audit--11-october-2026) confirms incomplete historical search execution metadata. Missing queries/dates remain UNKNOWN; a future template does not fill them.

Remaining checks refer to the [claim/method/access-depth ledger](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/0eea1360a100d21a190034cadf2c9f21a1f2a4bc/docs/english/research/06_RESEARCH_EXIT_EVIDENCE.md), [prior-art map and claim boundaries](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/0eea1360a100d21a190034cadf2c9f21a1f2a4bc/docs/english/research/09_RESEARCH_MASTER_20261010.md), and [D08 evidence/alternatives/uncertainty audit](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/0eea1360a100d21a190034cadf2c9f21a1f2a4bc/docs/english/research/14_D08_DEVELOPMENT_EVALUATION_20261010.md). UNKNOWN values and partial/abstract-only access remain explicit; no additional full-text inspection, systematic-review coverage, novelty or scientific efficacy is inferred. Required outputs are decision-useful at this bounded scope; exact search provenance remains incomplete and issue closure is not performed.

#64's two ambiguous testing/reference clauses are documented there rather than redefined. Scientific reference quality remains NOT MEASURED; exact amendment/D07/D08/F1 await owner acceptance; #70 NOT PASSED. This tracker creates no extra execution WIP.

## Research objective

Establish what SITES can defensibly claim and measure in M1 before implementation.

The central question is not “how to build a trend dashboard?” but:

> What construct can be measured from bounded scholarly evidence, with which simple signals, under which temporal/data limitations, and how does that relate to established prior art?

## Prior-art families to cover

At minimum investigate:

- definitions/characteristics of emerging technologies;
- bibliometrics / scientometrics and science mapping;
- temporal publication/concept frequency and normalization;
- burst detection and persistence;
- topic/concept evolution and terminology drift;
- citation dynamics only where historical observations actually exist;
- diffusion across venues/institutions where relevant;
- temporal leakage / retrospective vs as-of evaluation;
- reproducible computational research and evidence traceability;
- known failure modes of using counts/citations as proxies for importance, adoption, novelty, or technological superiority.

Historical SITES designs may be analyzed only as **internal historical material**, never as academic prior art.

## Evidence discipline

For material claims:

- [ ] record exact search query/service/date;
- [x] prefer primary papers/official primary sources;
- [x] record whether full text, abstract, metadata, or secondary citation was actually inspected;
- [x] capture population, period, method, result, limitations, counterevidence, and transfer risk to SITES;
- [x] distinguish VERIFIED / ASSUMPTION / UNKNOWN;
- [x] do not claim novelty without targeted searches for the proposed contribution and close synonyms;
- [x] retain negative evidence and methods that do not transfer cleanly to M1.

## Required outputs

This tracker is complete when linked research artifacts provide:

1. **Construct map** — what “trend/change/emergence” can and cannot mean in M1.
2. **Method matrix** — candidate simple signals, data requirements, strengths, failure modes, and temporal requirements.
3. **Claim-boundary table** — which outputs support descriptive scholarly-activity claims versus stronger claims that M1 must not make.
4. **Evaluation implications** — controls, historical case/control strategy, hindsight/holdout protections, and insufficient-evidence behavior.
5. **Gap statement** — what SITES M1 is testing that is not already assumed from prior art.
6. **Decision handoff** — explicit evidence links into the D08 package in #64 and source requirements passed to #65.

## Initial anchor sources

The existing provisional docs already mention examples such as Rotolo, Hicks & Martin (2015), Kleinberg (2002), and Sandve et al. (2013). Treat them as starting anchors only; verify exact claims and expand/criticize them rather than building the review around three familiar references.

## Definition of Done

- [x] Major M1 claims have source/evidence records.
- [x] At least one serious alternative to the preferred signal family is covered.
- [x] Important counterevidence/failure modes are explicit.
- [x] No literature result is presented as proof that a method works for the eventual SITES corpus.
- [x] #64 can cite this evidence map when preparing D08.
- [x] Remaining uncertainty is explicit enough to design the smallest empirical tests.

This issue closes when the prior-art/evidence map is decision-useful, not when a target paper count is reached.

## OWNER SCOPE DIRECTION — retrospective-only M1 (10/10/2026)

The owner reviewed the completed #65 investigation and #64 development-only evidence and confirmed **“chốt OK”** in the SITES control conversation after the [agent's execution report](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/issues/70#issuecomment-6097673774).

### Decision now recorded

1. **ACCEPT the completed #65 investigation outcome** (insufficient historical/as-of evidence) and the measured **D08 development-only exploratory research package** as a reviewable research result, *not* as evidence that the indicator detects technology trends or passes the product gate.
2. **SELECT Option B — retrospective-only as the M1 scope direction**, based on current feasibility evidence and the 15 October demo-ready target. **Authorize preparation of a controlled, explicit scope/estimand amendment and decision-ready D07/D08 packet for owner signature.** Do not pursue open-ended as-of reconstruction as the immediate M1 critical path. Future historical reconstruction remains an independently gated research direction.
3. **Preserve accepted D05/D06 and original E3 semantics until the exact amendment is reviewed and explicitly accepted.** This direction is **not** approval to declare the original E3 PASSED, silently replace it, or treat the 2026 current-query corpus as the complete June-2019 public state.

### Grounded review evidence

- [PR #75 @ 64da78b](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/commit/64da78be17f0b89bbd008f5033192742fd663046) remains Draft.
- [D08 report](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/64da78be17f0b89bbd008f5033192742fd663046/docs/vietnamese/research/14_D08_DEVELOPMENT_EVALUATION_20261010.md): January–June 2019 observed current-query, 598 distinct work/v1 title records; `N = 91/79/97/103/122/106`, `n = 0/1/2/1/4/1`, pooled 9/598 (1.5050%). An additional independent reaggregation of the committed normalized JSON confirmed the six denominators, numerators and all nine matched work IDs.
- [Verification](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/64da78be17f0b89bbd008f5033192742fd663046/experiments/research_exit_20260927/runs/20261010-signal-01/verification.json) reports 28 tool tests, 15 legacy synthetic checks, 10 controlled cases, two same-host corrected replays, 598 denominator ID checks, 9 source references. This review independently recalculated the result **from committed normalized JSON**, not a fresh second-machine raw-XML replay.
- Extremely sparse support (`0–4` title matches per month); historical public availability/category population and cutoff-valid vocabulary unresolved; independent reference annotation, minimum support, semantic detection quality and numerical quality threshold **NOT MEASURED / UNRESOLVED**. No growth/decline/emergence label has been validated. No holdout was viewed.

### Next conditional owner gate

Prepare a **single proposed retrospective amendment** spelling out:
- changed research target/estimand and claim boundary, with line-by-line impacts on D05, M1, original E3 and E1–E8; explicitly keep as-of statements prohibited;
- proposed D07 population = frozen observed `cs.SE` query (retrieved in 2026), v1-submission UTC bins, provenance, denominator and sampling/coverage limits;
- proposed D08 = v1 title lexical count plus normalized share, documented regex/version, no unsupported direction/emergence labels, support/abstention behavior;
- independent blinded 27-work semantic pilot protocol with owner-designated humans and disclosed post-output selection; this pilot is not yet executed and cannot establish trend-level accuracy;
- predeclared reference/quality/support criteria, exposure register, holdout overlap reconciliation and immutable freeze procedure, **before any future confirmatory evaluation**;
- residual risk, one bounded next test, and an explicit owner acceptance/rejection checklist.

**NOT ACCEPTED BY THIS COMMENT:** exact D07/D08 contract or threshold, experimental/holdout freeze, historical E3 pass, Research Exit #70 pass, D09 stack, implementation/deployment, PR merge. No automatic status change for D05–D09. **#64 and #70 remain OPEN; #65 remains completed; PR #75 remains Draft** until subsequent review. The direction approval should reduce decision latency, not substitute for scientific validation.

## Proposed M1-R-20261010-v1 — exact scope/D07/D08 owner decision packet

[VI unified packet](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/ed2a21f36b8b0b05efd889279717b61dbe777eda/docs/vietnamese/research/15_RETROSPECTIVE_SCOPE_AMENDMENT_20261010.md) · [EN](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/ed2a21f36b8b0b05efd889279717b61dbe777eda/docs/english/research/15_RETROSPECTIVE_SCOPE_AMENDMENT_20261010.md) · [commit ed2a21f](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/commit/ed2a21f36b8b0b05efd889279717b61dbe777eda) · [#64 execution/verification](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/issues/64#issuecomment-6097908418). One successful branch push in this execution; PR #75 remains Draft.

This prepares the exact amendment authorized by [owner direction](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/issues/70#issuecomment-6097713689). It does **not** accept it or pass this gate.

### Exact proposed change
M1 evaluates inspectable/reproducible **v1-title lexical prevalence within the 598 observed works of the frozen 2026 cs.SE query**, retrospectively binned by Jan–Jun 2019 UTC v1 submission. Preserve lineage, observation/derivation separation, deterministic replay, idempotency and D06. Give up historical public-state completeness/as-of vocabulary/availability and validated scientific trend-detection claims.

The packet maps every affected M1/D05 clause and E1–E8. **Original E3 remains NOT PASSED.** Separately proposed E3-R checks frozen population/version/event boundaries; E2-R evaluates fixed case/control, declared sensitivities, workflow correctness and later independent reviewer interpretation. These replacements require explicit acceptance; original requirements remain authoritative until then.

**D07 PROPOSED:** exact existing query, full 598 observed current-query works including nonmatches, frozen metadata/raw references, v1 identity, retrieval 10 October 2026 vs 2019 event time, denominator/missingness/coverage/selection bias and metadata-vs-paper sharing boundary.

**D08 PROPOSED:** unchanged versioned case-insensitive title regex, n/N and share; n=0/1/2/1/4/1 with N=91/79/97/103/122/106. Share requires valid fields and N≥1; unknowns yield null/bounds. Directional labels disabled at every support value. Sparse 0–4 support does not validate growth. All development sensitivity/negative evidence retained.

### Owner's subsequent simulation instruction — no scientific substitution
In this session the owner instructed: three roles explicitly **SIMULATED**; 27-work workflow tested on synthetic data; independent scientific quality **NOT MEASURED**; D08 may be accepted for a descriptive indicator only if other conditions are owner-approved; #70 may pass only against the accepted criteria, with no automatic bypass.

Executed synthetic fixture uses **27 fictional SYN IDs**, 54 A/B judgments, 18 designed agreements, nine disagreements/C adjudications, 9/9/9 final labels. **Zero real works annotated.** Seven new workflow tests and all 35 tool unit tests PASS; a second process reproduced synthetic semantic bytes. This is workflow correctness evidence, not independent annotator agreement, precision/recall, real-paper reference or product pipeline acceptance. The existing real 27-work pilot remains unexecuted; its blinded human protocol is retained for the route that requires it.

### Separate decisions awaiting owner signature
Record ACCEPT / REJECT / REVISE per packet §9, with owner/date/version/hash:
1. **A1:** exact retrospective estimand/claim limits and D05/M1 clause amendment.
2. **A2:** applicable E2-R/E3-R replacements, retaining historical E3 NOT PASSED.
3. **A3:** explicitly select limited descriptive-demo acceptance with independent scientific quality NOT MEASURED, **or** retain independent-reference quality as a #70 requirement and wait for real reference evidence. Simulation does not satisfy the latter.
4. **D07 / D08:** exact corpus/time/rule/formula/support/uncertainty/sensitivity/reference/evaluation contract.
5. **F1:** immutable prospective freeze with exposure, exact code/config/input/protocol hashes, criteria and proposed reviewer/budget checks. No current holdout access.
6. **G70:** explicit disposition only after all owner-selected research criteria have evidence; otherwise keep NOT PASSED with named gaps. Product E1–E8 and D09 are later gates, not claimed complete at Research Exit.

Recommendation remains **PROPOSED**: accept a narrowly labeled descriptive route if it matches owner value requirements; otherwise retain quality requirements and defer M1 rather than lowering them implicitly. No independent semantic/trend numerical threshold is justified by simulation. Proposed 60-second/256-MiB offline replay budget and five-question reviewer interpretation rubric remain unaccepted/unmeasured. One bounded next demo test after gates: independent reviewer interpretation/evidence opening/replay, not more open-ended historical searching.

Immutable packet Git-blob SHA-256: VI `164535e1d50fd6f01e26aaadb639d7a89f67dadfc2dd4412b75d93bd05b677b0`; EN `da80e30a4fb07ad7722cf4d845ce0feb7da28a1b84336710697f358cd30b8122`. [Validation/hash records](https://github.com/Dyu20705/sites/blob/ed2a21f36b8b0b05efd889279717b61dbe777eda/experiments/research_exit_20260927/runs/20261010-amendment-01/index-byte-verification.json) preserve exact staged identities; old raw/config/evaluator/measurements unchanged.

**Current: #64/#70 OPEN; #65 completed; D05/D06 ACCEPTED; D07/D08/D09 PROPOSED; original E3/#70 NOT PASSED.** No holdout query/read/write, D09/product implementation, merge, release or deployment. Deadline 15 October.
